purpose: Bind the retained F3/F4 negative evidence to a CPU-only remediation checklist without changing a threshold, submitting a job, or granting T2.

registered_gates.unknown_denominator: All geometric seeds in each source remain in the denominator; permanent unknown seeds are not dropped.

unknown_quality.interpretation: Mass closure does not repair a failing per-source unknown gate. Row 29 source 0 and both row 31 sources exceed 0.01.

native_cadence.prepared_dense_execution_status: prepared_only; dense CFD and paired material overlays not yet executed
substitution_forbidden: The existing .004 s center source cannot substitute for the required .002 s dense source.
An independent .02 s solve cannot substitute for matched decimation from a .002 s parent.
The q=1 endpoint has no dense parent source.

scope_coverage.resolution_source_mapping: all 24 rows map to existing F4 spatial source cells; material overlays remain pending

remediation_requirements.name: per_source_unknown_quality_closure
pass_requires: Every registered source reports a finite per-source unknown fraction at or below 0.01.
The denominator retains every geometric seed and does not use an aggregate-only pass.
Material summaries, checkpoint manifests, source bindings, and terminal receipts hash-check against the versioned implementation.
A repair or diagnostic variant is not counted without an independent fixed-gate acceptance record.

remediation_requirements.name: native_cadence_provenance_closure
pass_requires: F3 retains a native .002 s dense source and direct native-frame .01 s matched decimation with frame-map and source hashes.
F4 retains a native .002 s dense source and .02 s matched decimation from that same parent, with the registered physics fields unchanged.
No interpolation, independent .02 s solve, or .004 s source is substituted for a required native cadence product.
Cadence comparisons remain diagnostic until their source scope and independent acceptance records are complete.

remediation_requirements.name: registered_scope_and_event_closure
pass_requires: All 33 registered F3 rows have terminal, hash-bound evidence and an independent acceptance decision.
All 33 F4 overlay rows are represented by the registered 15-cell source mapping, with the five 4096-seed density overlays and four cadence rows closed.
Residence and event metrics use the full registered event window; right-censored or unresolved canaries remain diagnostic.

remediation_requirements.name: second_family_independent_acceptance
pass_requires: Two distinct material families each have an independently accepted macro T2 record under the same fixed gates.
A passing F3 or F4 diagnostic, mass closure, substep agreement, or repair proposal cannot satisfy the second-family gate.
The central registry remains unchanged until the independent acceptance records exist.

blocking_reasons: Per-source unknown gate fails on retained rows 29 and 31.
Terminal CDF bounds exceed the fixed 0.02 gate.
The 33-row matrix still contains active, blocked, and unsubmitted rows; observed cadence output is diagnostic only.
Every retained canary fails the 0.01 unknown gate.
The exact .002 s dense plus .02 s matched-decimation pair is incomplete.
The observed canaries are right-censored before the 4.34 s registered event window.
The 33-row overlay template has pending density, cadence, and independent acceptance records.

implementation_binding.binding_rule: A changed implementation hash invalidates this preflight until the JSON evidence and acceptance tests are regenerated; no stale code hash is treated as current.

input_evidence.role: current fixed-gate decision and terminal F3/F4 negative summary
F3 terminal row receipts and source-window provenance
F3 paired terminal comparison and denominator policy
F3 native dense versus direct native-frame matched cadence diagnostic
F3 cadence root verification and no-qualification decision
F4 retained canary negative evidence and right-censoring audit
F4 native cadence control design and prepared-only status
F4 33-row overlay mapping, 15-cell source coverage, and cadence gaps

prohibited_shortcuts: Do not relax the 0.01 unknown threshold or replace per-source denominators with aggregate mass.
Do not use a .004 s source, an independent .02 s solve, interpolation, or a right-censored canary as a native cadence or event acceptance substitute.
Do not convert diagnostic comparisons, mass closure, substep agreement, or repair proposals into T2 credit.
Do not submit GPU/CFD/solver work or mutate the central registry or ledger as part of this preflight.
interpretation_boundary: This artifact is a CPU-only evidence-closure and qualification-preflight record. It records why F3 and F4 remain blocked and lists fixed-gate prerequisites for a later review; it cannot grant T2 and does not change registry state.
